author: Bay State News
title: Gabriella Mikaul named Patriot League player of the week for women's tennis
text:
Sophomore Gabriella Mikaul of the Boston University women’s tennis team was named Patriot League player of the week, according to an April 14 announcement from the league. This marks her third weekly award of the season.
The recognition comes after Mikaul went undefeated in three matches during the final weekend of regular season play, helping Boston University secure wins against Lehigh and Army West Point. Against Lehigh, Mikaul partnered with junior Nancy Liu to win their doubles match 6-0 at the top spot. Her singles match was suspended during its third set as BU clinched a 4-0 team victory.
In competition against Army West Point, Mikaul and Liu won their doubles match 6-2 at line one, which contributed to securing the doubles point for BU. In singles play, Mikaul earned a straight-set victory at No. 1 singles by scores of 6-1 and 7-5, providing BU with its third point on their way to a 4-2 overall win.
Mikaul’s consistent performance has been key for Boston University throughout the season as she continues to collect individual honors while contributing crucial points in both singles and doubles matches.
Looking ahead, Mikaul and her teammates will compete as top seeds in the upcoming Patriot League Quarterfinal on Friday, April 17 at 9 a.m., where they will face either Lafayette or Holy Cross.
